summary: This note describes the 1955 NBA draft, the ninth annual draft of the National Basketball Association, held April 13, 1955, before the 1955–56 season. Eight NBA teams took turns selecting U.S. college players, selecting in reverse order of the previous season's win–loss record. The Milwaukee Hawks took part but relocated to St. Louis and became the St. Louis Hawks before the season began. The draft had 15 rounds and 96 players selected.
one_line: Overview of the ninth NBA draft, held April 13, 1955, with eight teams selecting 96 college players in 15 rounds.
key_facts: The 1955 NBA draft was the ninth annual draft of the National Basketball Association (NBA).
The draft was held on April 13, 1955, before the 1955–56 season.
Eight remaining NBA teams took turns selecting amateur U.S. college basketball players in the 1955 NBA draft.
In each round of the 1955 NBA draft, teams selected in reverse order of their win–loss record in the previous season.
The Milwaukee Hawks participated in the 1955 NBA draft.
The Milwaukee Hawks relocated to St. Louis, Missouri, and became the St. Louis Hawks prior to the start of the 1955–56 season.
The 1955 NBA draft consisted of 15 rounds.
The 1955 NBA draft comprised 96 players selected.
